`legacy.doc` is `__tests__/data/test01.doc` from
https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor/commit/d971d9f69056245ae129bd2ce31436d518293854
(MIT license in `WORD-EXTRACTOR-LICENSE.txt`). It exercises real Word 97–2003
compound-file parsing, including Unicode text.

The other comparison fixtures are generated locally by `comparison-fixtures.cjs`.
